This is your apartment building.
Or perhaps it is just as that fortune teller said...
I sure hope so.
Gillian! Are you just going to leave?
Let's capture whoever has snuck into your apartment!
I'll open the door. Are you ready?
Yeah! Open it!
This is definitely your building. The window of your apartment is visible from this side.
This is the apartment that the government arranged for you.
Not surprisingly, there are few pedestrians at this time of night.
There are no suspicious vehicles in the area.
It's hard to tell from here, but the lights are definitely on.
Maybe it's Katrina?
Somebody appears to be in the apartment.
The security system is on. It appears to be in order.
How could they get past the security system?
I do not see any unusual tracks or marks.
There are no suspicious people in the area, and I am not picking up any movement.
I can't limit the movement sensor to just your apartment.
What about your infra-red sensor?
I don't read anything. Apparently nobody is near the window.
I can't investigate from here.
Metal, check the status of the door of my apartment from here.
All right. Now accessing the building's security system...
Gillian. It's open.
It does not appear to have been forced.
What?! I know I locked that before I left!
This is Gillian's living room.
Let's check this room first.
Don't get too anxious, Gillian. Let's check out this room first.
Whoever broke in here may have set some kind of a trap for you.
Nobody appears to be in this room.
I don't see anybody in the room, and there are no places where a person could hide.
That's odd. The position of the chair and some of my stuff is different..
It looks like the chair and some of my stuff has been moved...
There are some faint depressions in the carpet that would indicate footprints.
They are significantly different from your footprints.
Nothing seems to have been stolen.
The surface temperature of the sofa is relatively high. It would appear that someone was sitting there a few minutes ago.
So at least it appears that I haven't been robbed.
I read no movement in this room.
These shoe impressions are very sharp and deep. Most of the weight of the person was focused on one point.
Something sharp? A SNATCHER?
So it's not Katrina, eh?
That possibility exists.
The footprints lead to the bathroom.
The sound seems to be coming from the bathroom.
The sound is coming from the bathroom.
Hmm? What's that smell?
A SNATCHER?
I'm not sure, but I've smelled that before somewhere...
<<sniff, sniff>> What is that smell? Something's in there!
Gillian! Aren't you going to uncover the source of this sound?
Gillian! You can't always be running away like that!
Your opponent won't be running, you know! Summon your courage!
This is the bathroom.
Hmm? It's really hot and humid in here...
There is something in the shower!!
There is no one in the room. The shower stall is the only place that someone could be hiding.
There's some underwear on the floor. I wonder whose it is?
Is this your thing, Gillian?
Don't be stupid! I don't know anything about it!
Oh? There's something on the floor.
Something has fallen on the floor.
Hmm... cute underwear.
...why is there underwear like this in my room?
Playing dumb, are we, Gillian?
The electronic blinds of the glass door prevent identification of whatever is in the stall.
The "In Use" sign is lit on the window.
I read movement! There's movement in this room.
The temperature and humidity in this room are climbing rapidly.
There's nothing here besides that underwear from before.
Is this... panties? Or... a bra?
Huh?
Shh, it's underwear! And women's, at that...
Women's underwear!
There's women's underwear on the floor.
My thermo sensor shows a region of concentrated heat. I would say that hot water is being used.
I read movement from within the stall!
It's silk underwear. Its owner must be someone who takes real care with her clothes. Underwear is a woman's ultimate weapon, after all.
The kind of woman who wears underwear like this is usually high society or a model.
A model?... Katrina?
T-this is... hers?
Then... Katrina's naked?
Gillian, don't let your guard down.
What if it's a SNATCHER?
What are you planning, taking your clothes off?
I'm going to put this underwear on.
I'm going to take a bath.
You're joking, right?
Yeah...
Maybe I'll just keep it...
I'm telling the Chief!
Metal! For the sake of the investigation, we need to examine this underwear. Go get it for me!!
I suppose it can't be helped... but you'd better give it back.
Honestly, you're already holding it, aren't you?
All right! Let's have a sniff. Sniff, sniff... Mmm! Nice smell. Huh?... This smell?
So that's the kind of thing you're into...
Don't tell anyone. ...Hey! That's not it... This smell, could it be...?
What's wrong?
That's it, this smell!
Is it Katrina?
...I want to think so.
I knew it! Metal, I've got it! This smell!
Sniff, sniff... smells kind of sweaty?
You've been so busy with the investigation, you haven't had a bath, have you?
Come to think of it, I haven't...
Do I smell bad?
It doesn't bother me, but...
Haven't done laundry either. Girls are going to hate me at this rate.
(Looking at her like this, she's pretty coquettish...)
(Something... feels kind of strange...)
Is there something on my face?
What?! Gillian, are you mad?
(Hmm. Pretty glamorous!)
(Bad for a single guy's eyes...)
(So sexy...)
(...Women are devils.)
I'm going to need to check out your towel...
Don't you ever quit!? I know what you have in mind!
Stop teasing me, Gillian.
Can I take a look at that hospital list?
Go ahead...take a look.
Well then, why don't I take a bath too?
Gillian! This isn't the time for that!
Ugh!! You keep saying stuff like that! You just want to see me naked, don't you!
Metal Gear, I need a favor. Get me a bath towel!
Using my full name won't help. Why should I have to do that?
What are you two talking about?
Gillian! Knock it off already!!
Maybe you should get some clothes on.
Huh? I just took a shower, so I'm a little hot. I'd like to stay like this.
Katrina, I can loan you some of my clothes...
I may take you up on that...in a few minutes.
(No, no. You're just fine the way you are!)
Katrina, you'll catch a cold!
Okay Gillian. I'll borrow some of your clothes, okay?
Uh, wait a second. Before that, we need to talk.
It's about Alice.
What's wrong with Alice?
You see, Alice is...
Gillian!!
Um, uh...
What's wrong?
Forget it. I'll tell you later.
You're weird.
Alice is a fine dog.
Isn't she? She's my only family now.
(Oh jeez. I can't tell her the dog's dead!)
A fortune teller helped me find you.
A fortune teller?
Yes, a retinal reading woman over in Alton Plaza.
Oh, that con artist, eh?
What? You know her?
Yeah. That woman's famous. But after a bunch of magazines reported that she was a fraud, she lost a lot of business!
...what?
You're way behind the times, aren't you! I can't believe you paid her money!
About that phone call... would you tell me what that was all about?
That's right! When I was straightening up the living room, I found this inside that model of our house.
Oh yeah, there was a model of Gibson's house on the shelf, wasn't there.
It's a list of hospitals!
It appears to be a list of illicit medical facilities.
It lists the name of the hospital, its director's name, its address and area of specialty.
Well then the SNATCHER's place, the one that Gibson found, must be on this list!
So that's what that "Search the house" note that Gibson left meant.
He was just a little too clever this time...
Will this list be of any help?
This list has over 3,000 places listed on it. We could never hit them all. We need some other information to narrow it down.
What about the image from Little John's memory? That should be the key!
If you type in the name of the hospital, I'll scan the list for you.
...I think somebody was following me.
I'm sure they were after my dad's list. But I couldn't get in touch with you!
Sorry about that. I should have given you Metal Gear's number.
I called before I entered your apartment, but I couldn't get in touch with you.
Do you know anything about this list of hospitals?
I've never seen it before. But if my dad kept it in the house model, it must have been really important.
I'm sure the hospital my dad found is on it.
He didn't make any marks on the list, so there must be some other key.
How old are you, Katrina?
I turned 18 this year.
Oh really? (Jeez, I can't believe how quick kids grow up these days...)
Even so, I'm pretty old for a model.
(Oh great, so what does that make Jamie?)
Gillian! You've got things more important than her age that you need to be asking her!
Gillian, you better control yourself, or you'll get her angry again.
Yeah, you're right.
After all, you've got a bad track record.
Hey, don't talk about me like I'm a criminal or something.
All right, Gillian. Let's see if we can find the SNATCHER'S hospital on this list.
What about that hospital that was in Little John's memory.
Why don't you give a name similar to the one on that sign.
Give me a name along the lines of the one on the sign.
The sign said "Oleen" didn't it.
Input the name of the hospital that you want to search for.
Queens, right? Okay...
You've tried almost all the different chess piece names, haven't you.
All right, now searching...
It's here! Queens Hospital!
Great! You found it Gillian!
Just as Katrina said, wasn't it?
I'm so happy...
So the neon tube was burned out, eh? And there were more letters to the word than shown in the picture...
So "Queens" looked like "Oleen".
That's what the chess piece was trying to tell us.
Queen, right? Okay, now searching...
Hmm. It seems very close, but something is missing. Hang in there!
...Though I do like a good crane game.
Sure, well then... win one for me sometime?
...Katrina.
Oh, sorry.
Owen, right? Now searching...
Auren, right? Now searching...
Ohrin, right? Now searching...
Not surprisingly, the only one is that veterinary hospital.
Oleen, right? Okay, now searching...
Let's try to think of something other than Oleen...
...Come to think of it, wasn't there a song like this once?
Oleen, Oleen, Olee... Oleeeen...?
Isn't that "Jolene"?
Oh, was it...
Let's try to think of something other than Oleen...
All right, as Katrina suggested... "Oleena," then...
All right, as Katrina suggested... "Oleens," then...
Oleenu?
Sounds kind of like Katrina, doesn't it?
It doesn't sound alike at all...
Is that right, "Oleenu"?
It's Katrina!
...'Orin'? ...'orin'?
What's wrong, Gillian?
I've heard a name like that before. I think it was... Kito...
...Isn't that from some novel?
Come on, be serious.
The king...
A bishop...
A knight...
What names does "Oleen" bring to mind?
That sign is definitely for that hospital, right?
The visual image of "Oleen" is almost certainly correct.
So "Oleen" is the starting point, right? Maybe we're reading it wrong?
If one of the neon tubes were burned out, the letters could change, couldn't they.
Oleen could be misleading, then.
If the neon were broken, it might look like different letters.
Why don't we try adding parts to the letters of "Oleen" to see if we can make something else?
And something related to that particular chess piece that we found.
And something related to chess.
It depends on how you interpret "Oleen".
As long as there was no corruption of the image, we can be sure that the strokes in the letters in "Oleen" actually exist, right?
It's a wooden chess piece. This is the one that goes next to the king.
...you mean the queen, right?
Do you have any idea what this chess piece might mean?
It must have something to do with that hospital. My dad took good care of his chess set. That's really odd for him to be carrying one of the pieces around with him.
Maybe this piece's rank has some meaning.
Maybe this chess piece has something to do with the name of the hospital.
This chess piece is a "queen," right?
Katrina, what do you think?
What about "Queens?" I bet the name of the hospital is "Queens".
Gillian, what don't you look for a hospital named "Queens?"
Gillian?! Where are you looking?!
You're looking somewhere weird again!! You're thinking something naughty, aren't you!!
Gillian... don't stare so much.
Please input something!
You haven't input anything at all!
...it's not on the list.
No. It's not here.
No, the name must be different.
Think hard about the name in that picture.
I'll bring up Little John's memory. Think carefully...
Maybe additional letters appear after the N.
Yeah. Oleen something. Maybe Oleens, or Oleena?
Come to think of it, that "Great Meals" sign in Alton Plaza was burned out, making a different reading, wasn't it.
Maybe that burned out "Great Meals" neon sign in Alton Plaza is some kind of a hint.
Yeah! I bet part of the neon is burned out!
If part of the sign was burned out, the letters would appear differently.
I get it! The neon's burned out! Now I've got it!
That's right! Jean had a chess piece with him. That must have some meaning.
That's right! Jean had a chess piece with him. That must have some meaning.
I wonder what that chess piece was?
Think carefully about it. There is no hospital called "Oleen"...
...and part of the sign may have been burned out...
...and that chess piece must have had some meaning.
Wait. Maybe...
What?
Oh, nothing. I just had a wild idea.
Why don't we check Katrina's idea as well?
I see. It's the name of the chess piece.
That's the only thing I can think of from the chess piece.
That video image sure doesn't suggest it.
I think that's a bit different from Gibson's chess piece.
Gillian, I just checked that name.
Just to be on the safe side.
Check it again for me, will you?
You want to check it again? I don't think it will be there...
